entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it about a month ago and I just can't get the hang of it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered on December 15th, so about 30 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just... it's really hard to use. The app is so confusing. I really expected more, to be honest. I tried reading the user manual and it didn't help at all. I feel completely lost. Can't you just help me?
I certainly understand the frustration when a new device isn't intuitive. Let me just check our return policy for you.

Alright, I've just pulled up our policy information. It looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 30, you're well within that window. I can approve this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just processed the authorization. You'll receive an email within the hour containing a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the sensor in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office.
That's wonderful. You've been a great help, Charlie.
I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
